compatibility: Core Fyrlet, @fyrlet/client and @fyrlet/react are released together at the same version. During 0.x, consumers must use the matching release line and review the contract before upgrading.
deprecation: Before 1.0.0, incompatible changes may occur in minor versions. Deprecations must identify the affected release and replacement; removal requires a subsequent release and migration path.
registries: The intended public registries are Hex.pm for fyrlet and npm for @fyrlet/client and @fyrlet/react. Package-name ownership, registry credentials and publication approval remain external maintainer gates.
